_meta._note: Deep-mined paper PDFs already in resource/: (1) DeepSeek-Math-V2 arxiv 2511.22570, (2) Goedel-Prover-V2 arxiv 2508.03613, (3) DeepSeek-Prover-V2 arxiv 2504.21801. Strict primary-source attribution — every (model, benchmark, value) triple is explicitly stated in the original paper. New benchmarks: cmo_2024, proofnet, imo_proofbench_basic, imo_proofbench_advanced. Existing benchmark imo_2025 reuses 35/42 = 83.3% IMO scoring for DeepSeekMath-V2 (matches Gemini Deep Think entry).

benchmarks.name: CMO 2024 (China Mathematical Olympiad)
benchmarks.description: China Mathematical Olympiad 2024 — 6 proof-based problems, 42-point scale (7 per problem). Gold-medal cutoff ~21/42. Reported by DeepSeekMath-V2 paper (arxiv 2511.22570).

benchmarks.name: ProofNet (Lean 4 test split)
benchmarks.description: 186 undergraduate-level theorem proving problems in Lean 4 (real/complex analysis, linear algebra, abstract algebra, topology). Test split per DeepSeek-Prover-V2 paper.

benchmarks.name: IMO-ProofBench Basic
benchmarks.description: DeepMind IMO-ProofBench Basic set — 30 problems at pre-IMO to IMO-Medium difficulty, expert-graded human evaluation. Introduced by Luong et al. 2025 (EMNLP).

benchmarks.name: IMO-ProofBench Advanced
benchmarks.description: DeepMind IMO-ProofBench Advanced set — 30 challenging problems simulating complete IMO examinations up to IMO-Hard level. Expert-graded.

scores._note: DeepSeekMath-V2 Table 1: IMO 2025 P1,P2,P3,P4,P5 fully solved = 83.3% = 35/42 (gold-medal). Same scoring as Gemini Deep Think entry.
DeepSeekMath-V2 Table 1: CMO 2024 = 73.8% — solved P1,P2,P4,P5,P6 with partial credit on one. Gold-medal performance.
DeepSeekMath-V2 (Heavy) on IMO-ProofBench Basic = 99.0% per Figure 3 (expert evaluation), outperforming DeepMind DeepThink IMO Gold (89.0%) and Gemini Deep Think IMO lite (83.8%).

DeepSeekMath-V2 (Heavy) on IMO-ProofBench Advanced = 61.9% per Figure 3 (expert eval). Beats GPT-5 (37.6%), Gemini Deep Think IMO lite (24.8%), and Gemini Deep Think IMO Gold (65.7% — also DeepMind's highest).
Goedel-Prover-V2-32B Table 2: MiniF2F pass@32 with self-correction = 90.4% (88.1% without self-correction). Outperforms DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B (82.4% pass@32) and Kimina-Prover-72B (84.0% pass@32).
Goedel-Prover-V2-8B Table 2: MiniF2F pass@32 with self-correction = 86.7% (84.6% without). Despite 80x smaller, outperforms DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B (82.4% pass@32).
DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B (CoT) Table 1: MiniF2F-test pass@8192 = 88.9% (82.4% pass@32). Previous SOTA for whole-proof generation before Goedel-Prover-V2.
DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B (CoT) Table 4: ProofNet-test pass@1024 = 37.1% (30.5% pass@32). Strong generalization from high-school training to college-level theorem proving.
